Needs runtime measurement (Experimenter).", "Whether tl.max over axis 0 of a 1-D N-length tensor and tl.sum reductions in this Triton version match intended semantics (source-level assumption).", "Does the structured V offset (center=0.5) actually produce a cancellation regime where E exceeds budget, or does the 0.001*sqrt(D) denominator floor absorb it?"], "risk_map": ["FP16 quantization of softmax probabilities p (line 15) is the dominant error source: ~2^-11 relative error per probability, weighted by |V| rows;
